hero.intro: TonRa is a security-focused Telegram bot built to help users analyze wallets, tokens, and projects in the TON ecosystem. By scanning for suspicious activity, scam patterns, fake airdrops, and other potential risks, TonRa gives you a clearer view before you interact with a wallet, buy a token, or trust a new project.
hero.devNote: Some features are still under development.

whatIs.title: What is TonRa?
body: TonRa is a Telegram-based security and research bot built for the TON ecosystem. It helps users quickly check wallets, tokens, and projects before interacting with them, making it easier to identify possible risks, scams, or suspicious activity.

The TON ecosystem is growing fast, with new tokens, communities, airdrops, and projects appearing every day. While this creates many opportunities, it also makes it harder for users to know which wallets, tokens, or projects are trustworthy. TonRa is designed to make this process simpler, faster, and safer.

With TonRa, users can scan and review TON-related information directly through Telegram. The bot helps highlight warning signs such as suspicious wallet behavior, risky token activity, fake airdrop patterns, or projects that may require extra caution.

TonRa is not just a scanner. It is a practical safety assistant for anyone using TON. Whether you are checking a token before buying, reviewing a wallet before sending funds, or verifying a project before joining an airdrop, TonRa gives you clearer information so you can make better decisions.

wallet.desc: Review wallet behavior before sending funds.

project.title: Identify risky projects
project.desc: Spot suspicious or risky project behavior early.

airdrop.desc: Recognize possible scam campaigns and fake airdrops.

overview.title: Quick risk overview
overview.desc: Get a quick risk summary directly inside Telegram.

decisions.title: Safer decisions
decisions.desc: Make better-informed choices when exploring TON.

why.title: Why TonRa matters
why.body: Crypto users often need to make quick decisions, but scam projects can look professional and trustworthy at first glance. TonRa helps reduce this uncertainty by giving users a simple way to investigate before they act. Instead of relying only on social media posts, project claims, or community hype, users can use TonRa as an additional layer of protection. It helps bring more transparency to the TON ecosystem and supports safer participation for both beginners and experienced users.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content:
UTAA Blockchain Community ("we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform and services.

This policy complies with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK) and applicable international data protection regulations including GDPR where relevant.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.content:
Personal Information: When you register or use our services, we collect information such as your name, email address, educational background, department, interests, and contact information.

Usage Data: We automatically collect information about how you interact with our platform, including IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and timestamps.

Authentication Data: When you sign in through third-party providers (e.g., Google OAuth), we receive basic profile information as permitted by those services.

Educational Data: Course enrollment, progress, quiz results, certificates earned, and learning activities.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.content:
• To provide and maintain our educational platform and community services
  • To process your registration and manage your account
  • To deliver courses, track progress, and issue certificates
  • To organize and manage events, workshops, and community activities
  • To send you important updates, announcements, and educational content
  • To improve our services through analytics and user feedback
  • To ensure security and prevent fraud or unauthorized access
  • To comply with legal obligations and protect our legal rights

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing and Disclosure
dataSharing.content:
We do not sell your personal data. We may share your information in the following circumstances:

  • Service Providers: With trusted third-party service providers who assist in operating our platform (hosting, email services, analytics)
  • Legal Requirements: When required by law, court order, or governmental authority
  • Protection: To protect our rights, property, safety, or that of our users
  • Consent: With your explicit consent for specific purposes
  • Business Transfers: In connection with any merger, acquisition, or sale of assets (with proper notifications)

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include:

  • Encryption of data in transit and at rest
  • Regular security assessments and updates
  • Access controls and authentication mechanisms
  • Secure backup and recovery procedures
  • Staff training on data protection

However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

yourRights.title: Your Rights (KVKK Article 11)
yourRights.content:
Under KVKK Article 11 and applicable data protection laws, you have the right to:

  • Learn whether your personal data is being processed
  • Request information about the processing of your data
  • Learn the purpose of data processing and whether it is used for its intended purpose
  • Know third parties to whom your data has been transferred domestically or abroad
  • Request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data
  • Request deletion or destruction of your data under certain conditions
  • Request notification of correction, deletion, or destruction to third parties
  • Object to processing that leads to unfavorable consequences
  • Request data portability
  • Withdraw your consent at any time

To exercise these rights, please visit our KVKK Data Request page or contact us directly.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.content:
We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage patterns, and improve our services. Cookie categories include:

  • Essential Cookies: Required for basic functionality (always enabled)
  • Analytics Cookies: Help us understand usage patterns
  • Performance Cookies: Optimize site performance
  • Marketing Cookies: Deliver relevant updates (requires consent)

You can manage your cookie preferences through our Privacy Center or browser settings.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content:
Our platform integrates with third-party services including:

  • Google OAuth: For authentication (subject to Google's privacy policy)
  • Cloud Hosting: For data storage and platform infrastructure
  • Email Services: For transactional and marketing communications
  • Analytics: To understand platform usage and improve services

These third parties have their own privacy policies and data practices. We encourage you to review their policies before using their services through our platform.

international.title: International Data Transfers
international.content:
Your data may be transferred to and processed in countries outside Turkey, including the European Union and the United States, where our service providers are located. We ensure that all cross-border data transfers comply with KVKK Article 9 and include appropriate safeguards such as:

  • Standard contractual clauses approved by authorities
  • Adequacy decisions recognizing equivalent data protection
  • Your explicit consent where required

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: Our services are intended for university students and professionals aged 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under 18 without parental consent. If you believe we have inadvertently collected data from a minor, please contact us immediately.

updates.title: Updates to This Policy
updates.content:
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, legal requirements, or other factors. We will notify you of material changes through:

  • Email notifications to registered users
  • Prominent notices on our platform
  • Updated "Last Modified" date at the top of this policy

Your continued use of our services after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

We will respond to your inquiries within 30 days as required by KVKK.

about.title: What is UTAAB?
about.p1: UTAAB (Unified Turkic Academic Alliance for Blockchain) is a student-led ecosystem focused on Web3 education, real projects, and cross-border collaboration. We exist to lower the entry barrier to blockchain — so anyone curious can understand it, build with it, and contribute to it.
about.p2: Our content is free, our community is open, and our goal is simple: turn beginners into capable Web3 builders through clear lessons and hands-on projects.

clarity.title: Clarity over jargon

vision.title: Vision
vision.intro: UTAAB exists to make blockchain understandable, useful, and open to everyone. We believe Web3 should not be locked behind jargon, paywalls, or insider networks.
vision.p1: Make Web3 education accessible to anyone, regardless of background or budget.
vision.p2: Bridge the gap between learning and shipping by giving members real projects to build on.
vision.p3: Create a borderless community where students, developers, and mentors collaborate as equals.

tech.title: Technology
tech.intro: Our approach is intentionally pragmatic. We use technology that is open, well-understood, and battle-tested — and we explain everything we use.

t1.title: Open ecosystem
t1.description: We rely on open standards and public blockchains rather than locked-down platforms. Anything we publish, you can inspect.

t2.title: Education-first stack
t2.description: Our learning platform combines structured courses, hands-on workshops, and an AI tutor so members can learn at their own pace.

t3.title: Project pipeline
t3.description: Members move from learning to building through guided projects, mentorship, and contributor matching.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.intro: Three phases. We move on once the previous one is real, not just announced.

phase1.p1: Launch core education platform with multilingual support (EN, TR, RU, AR).
phase1.p2: Publish beginner-to-advanced learning guides and the official MIT "Blockchain and Money" course.
phase1.p3: Grow the global community across student chapters and online channels.

phase2.p1: Open contributor program with mentorship, paid bounties, and project tracks.
phase2.p2: Ship the first cohort of UTAAB-supported open-source Web3 projects.
phase2.p3: Launch a transparent governance model for community decisions.

phase3.p1: Hackathons, partnerships, and cross-border collaborations at scale.
phase3.p2: On-chain credentials and verifiable certificates for completed programs.
phase3.p3: Long-term sustainability model funded by partners, grants, and ecosystem contributions.

whitepaper.disclaimer: This page is a living summary of our direction and may evolve as the ecosystem grows. Nothing here is financial advice or a token sale offering.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Honest, plain-language answers to the questions we hear most often.

q1.a: UTAAB is a student-led Web3 ecosystem focused on blockchain education, real projects, and cross-border collaboration. We give beginners a clear path into Web3 — from first guide to first shipped project.

q2.a: Yes. The community, the guides, and most courses are free. Some advanced or partner programs may have a fee, but it will always be clearly labeled.

q3.q: I have zero blockchain experience. Where do I start?
q3.a: Start with our Guides at /learn/guides. The "Beginner" section explains what blockchain is, how wallets work, and the basic vocabulary — in plain language with real examples.

q4.q: Do I need to buy crypto to participate?
q4.a: No. You can learn everything and join most activities without owning any crypto. When projects do require an on-chain action, we use free testnets so nothing is at risk.

q5.q: What is a wallet, and is it safe to use one?
q5.a: A wallet is software that stores the keys giving you access to your blockchain accounts. Used correctly — strong backups, never share your secret phrase — it is safe. Our wallets guide walks through best practices step by step.

q6.a: A token model is in design. We will publish full details — supply, utility, distribution — only when finalized and reviewed. Anyone offering you a "UTAAB token" before the official announcement is not legitimate.

q7.q: How can I contribute to UTAAB?
q7.a: Visit /contributor-match. Tell us your skills and interests, and we'll match you with a project, task, or mentor. Designers, writers, developers, and community builders are all welcome.

q8.a: Read the blog at /blog for major updates and follow us on LinkedIn, Telegram, Instagram, X, and GitHub — links are in the footer.

q9.q: Do I get a certificate after completing a course?
q9.a: Yes. UTAAB EDU courses issue completion certificates that you can share on LinkedIn or download as a PDF.

q10.q: How do you handle my personal data?
q10.a: We follow KVKK and GDPR principles. You can read the full Privacy Policy or open the Privacy Center from the footer at any time to manage your preferences.

cta.title: Still have questions?
cta.subtitle: Reach out at contact@utaab.org or join the community — we read every message.
